title: Preallocate the Buffer
goal: Build a formatted tag string with minimal allocations.
hints: Concatenating `&str` directly using `+` does not compile because `&str` does not implement `Add`.
`String::with_capacity` reserves memory upfront and `push_str` populates the buffer without unnecessary reallocations.
explanation: `String::with_capacity` preallocates buffer capacity upfront. Constructing strings via direct `&str` concatenation leads to compilation errors, while using `format!` with wrong delimiters fails test assertions.
